headline: Iraq Border Shutdown With Iran Risks Economic Disruption
summary: The closure of the Al-Sheeb border crossing between Iraq and Iran threatens to disrupt trade and increase costs for businesses and consumers if the shutdown is prolonged.
why: Geopolitical tensions and border closures can disrupt regional supply chains and trade flows, impacting commodity prices and the economic stability of the involved nations.

impacts.name: Iraq
impacts.why: Border closures disrupt trade and increase costs, which can negatively impact the domestic economy and consumer prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
